description: This file contains Makefile snippets and definitions related to building root filesystem images, including conditional functions for mklibs, opkg, apk, and root filesystem preparation scripts.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Defines a function to find and process executable and shared object files, then uses mklibs to generate stripped libraries and copies them to target directories.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Defines a function to clean up opkg package info files and status, removing unnecessary files and resetting certain fields.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Defines a function to prepare the root filesystem directory, run post-install scripts, clean up version control files, and invoke other setup functions.
